quarterly_data.signal: HPE's 10-K XBRL customer concentration facts show an unnamed Customer One at 10% of revenue for fiscal 2025 (2024-11-01 to 2025-10-31), 14% for fiscal 2024 (2023-11-01 to 2024-10-31) and 11% for fiscal 2023 (2022-11-01 to 2023-10-31), and an unnamed Customer Two at 11% of revenue for fiscal 2024.
HPE's 10-K XBRL segment revenue: Server $17.64B for fiscal year 2024-11-01 to 2025-10-31, up 11.4% YoY from $15.83B.
HPE's 10-K XBRL segment revenue: Networking $6.84B for fiscal year 2024-11-01 to 2025-10-31, up 51.9% YoY from $4.50B.
